releaseNotes:
💎 Lossless FLAC Audio: Native 24-bit studio master and 16-bit CD-quality uncompressed audio tiers.
🖼️ High-Res Artwork: Fixed blurry and low-resolution cover art with crisp high-definition image decoding.
🎤 Seamless Lyrics: Fixed lyric gaps, timing drift across crossfade transitions, and added animated interlude dots.
📥 YouTube Playlist Imports: Fixed import limits and crashes on large playlists, now importing 500+ tracks accurately.
⚡ Enhanced Performance & Stability: Fixed rapid-skip metadata freezes, crushed playback bugs, and smoothed UI rendering.
